info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Sodalite Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Catalog Sodalite Syrup Detail API is designed for managing detailed entries of Sodalite syrup in the product catalog. This API enables businesses to submit and enrich product details, catering to various consumer needs like inventory management and product listings. Typical users include e-commerce platforms, inventory managers, and product teams aiming to create an accurate and robust product database. Through the API, users can effectively enhance their catalog's information and ensure high-quality product visibility.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create detailed information for Sodalite Syrup, supporting the addition of new entries with specific attributes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit the details of the sodalite syrup. It must conform to the required schema, which includes all the necessary fields for processing the syrup details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved details for the sodalite syrup.

sodalite_syrup_id.description: The unique identifier for the Sodalite syrup.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the individual requesting the Sodalite syrup.

quantity.description: The quantity of Sodalite syrup requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the Sodalite syrup.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the Sodalite syrup packaging.

warehouseCodes.description: A list of warehouse codes where the Sodalite syrup is stored.

items.description: A code corresponding to a specific warehouse.

width.description: The width of the packaging in specified units.

height.description: The height of the packaging in specified units.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions, such as cm or inches.

Dimensions.description: Schema representing the dimensions of the Sodalite syrup packaging.
